<?php
/**
 * Provisions the clean WordPress page structure used by the approved mockups.
 *
 * @package AgadirConceptDesignUniverses
 */

namespace Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Creates only structural WordPress objects. It never injects HTML/CSS content.
 */
final class Provisioner {
	/**
	 * Create missing pages and configure the static front page.
	 *
	 * @return array<string, mixed>
	 */
	public static function provision(): array {
		$result = array(
			'created'   => array(),
			'existing'  => array(),
			'failed'    => array(),
			'front_page' => 0,
		);
		$ids = array();

		foreach ( Page_Map::pages() as $slug => $definition ) {
			$path_parts = explode( '/', $definition['path'] );
			$page_slug  = sanitize_title( (string) end( $path_parts ) );
			$parent_id  = 0;

			if ( count( $path_parts ) > 1 ) {
				$parent_path = implode( '/', array_slice( $path_parts, 0, -1 ) );
				$parent      = get_page_by_path( $parent_path, OBJECT, 'page' );
				if ( ! $parent instanceof \WP_Post ) {
					$result['failed'][ $slug ] = 'Parent page is missing: ' . $parent_path;
					continue;
				}
				$parent_id = (int) $parent->ID;
			}

			$existing = get_page_by_path( $definition['path'], OBJECT, 'page' );
			if ( $existing instanceof \WP_Post ) {
				$ids[ $slug ]              = (int) $existing->ID;
				$result['existing'][ $slug ] = (int) $existing->ID;
				self::prepare_elementor_page( (int) $existing->ID );
				continue;
			}

			$post_id = wp_insert_post(
				wp_slash(
					array(
						'post_type'    => 'page',
						'post_status'  => 'publish',
						'post_title'   => $definition['label'],
						'post_name'    => $page_slug,
						'post_parent'  => $parent_id,
						'post_content' => '',
					)
				),
				true
			);

			if ( is_wp_error( $post_id ) ) {
				$result['failed'][ $slug ] = $post_id->get_error_message();
				continue;
			}

			$ids[ $slug ]             = (int) $post_id;
			$result['created'][ $slug ] = (int) $post_id;
			self::prepare_elementor_page( (int) $post_id );
		}

		if ( ! empty( $ids['accueil'] ) ) {
			update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
			update_option( 'page_on_front', (int) $ids['accueil'] );
			$result['front_page'] = (int) $ids['accueil'];
		}

		return $result;
	}

	/**
	 * Prepare one page for Elementor without injecting a page design.
	 *
	 * @param int $post_id Page ID.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function prepare_elementor_page( int $post_id ): void {
		update_post_meta( $post_id, '_elementor_edit_mode', 'builder' );
		update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wp_page_template', 'elementor_header_footer' );
		if ( ! metadata_exists( 'post', $post_id, '_elementor_data' ) ) {
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_elementor_data', '[]' );
		}
		delete_post_meta( $post_id, '_elementor_css' );
		clean_post_cache( $post_id );
	}
}
